page.overview:
What is Charcoal?

Charcoal is an item obtained by smelting logs or wood. It is used as fuel, or for crafting torches and campfires. Unlike coal, charcoal cannot be traded with villagers, nor can it be crafted into a block of coal. Coal and charcoal cannot stack together either. It can be used as a substitute for coal, as both charcoal and coal have an equivalent duration when smelted.

A campfire broken without the Silk Touch enchantment drops 2 charcoal.

Charcoal can be created from its base elements, using the compound creator.
